name: FIR Echo
description: 32 kHz stereo echo with 8-tap signed 1.7 fixed-point FIR filter (RAW, WARM, METAL, CAVE), beat-sync, and 16-bit sat/wrap.

params.name: FIR
params.explanation: SNES S-DSP 8-tap signed 1.7 FIR preset (RAW, WARM, METAL, CAVE).

params.name: Sync
params.explanation: Beat-synced note subdivision (FREE = Time in 20..700 ms; 1/16..1/4. = beat-synced with Time as 60..200 BPM).

params.name: Time
params.explanation: Echo time (20..700 ms when Sync=FREE) or Tempo (60..200 BPM when beat-synced; 43 = 120 BPM).

params.name: SatWrap
params.explanation: 0 = clean 16-bit saturation, 100 = classic SNES S-DSP signed 16-bit overflow wraparound.

params.name: Level
params.explanation: Master output level (80 is unity gain).

params.name: ON/OFF
params.explanation: LATCH: normal toggle. UNLATCH: momentary while held.
